Manchmal brennt ein Licht in deinem Auge: Sometimes a light burns in the corner of your eye that no one else can see.
Dein Schatten fällt zur Lampe hin, nicht: Your shadow falls towards the lamp, not away from it.
Deine Finger knoten unsichtbare Fäden, a: Your fingers knot invisible threads, even in your sleep.

Zwischen allen Menschen siehst du dünne: You see thin lines between all people. Some of them pull at you.
Im Spiegel lächelt manchmal jemand, der: Sometimes someone who isn't you smiles back from the mirror. Merchants notice that something is off.
Morgens brauchst du einen Moment, um zu: In the morning it takes you a moment to know which face is yours.
Die Stimmen sind leiser geworden, aber s: The voices have grown quieter, but now they lie. They tell you everything is fine.
Was du sagst, hörst du einen Atemzug spä: Whatever you say, you hear again a breath later, from somewhere.
Dein Atem riecht nach verbrannten Kräute: Your breath smells of burnt herbs. Merchants wrinkle their noses.
Beim Abmessen zittern deine Hände, als w: When you measure, your hands tremble as if they wanted to pour in more.
Ein Teil von dir fühlt nichts mehr. Das: Part of you feels nothing anymore. It doesn't make you calmer, only colder.
Wenn du blutest, riecht es nach altem Me: When you bleed, it smells of old metal.
Deine Gelenke klicken wie Schlösser, die: Your joints click like locks springing open. Every blow makes something inside you snap open.
Geschlossene Türen flüstern dir zu, was: Closed doors whisper to you what lies behind them. Mostly they lie.
Du kannst nichts kaufen, ohne es dreimal: You can't buy anything without weighing it in your hand three times. Merchants grow impatient.
Du stehst immer ein wenig schief, als lä: You always stand a little crooked, as if a weight lay on one side.
Du riechst nach Moor, egal wie oft du di: You smell of the moor no matter how often you wash. Merchants don't like paying much for goods that smell of the moor.
Deine Haut bleibt kalt und feucht, auch: Your skin stays cold and damp, even by the fire.
In deinem Ohr tickt eine Uhr, die nie st: A clock ticks in your ear that never stops.
Manchmal fehlen dir Sekunden. Du stehst: Sometimes seconds go missing. You stand there, and the world has moved on a little.
Jeder Treffer, den du einsteckst, kostet: Every hit you take costs {0} nerve.

Die Unruhe ebbt ab. Das war knapp, knapp: The unrest ebbs away. That was close, closer than ever before.
